svg.title: Three exposures, three dilutions — share of revenue that is robotics
svg.desc: NVIDIA's robotics-related revenue is about 1% (the rest is Data Center); Teradyne's Robotics is about 10% (the rest is semiconductor test); FANUC's robots are about 41% (and even those are mostly traditional industrial arms). All three have under half their revenue in robots, yet on earnings the valuation is inverted: NVIDIA is the cheapest and Teradyne the most expensive.
svg.text: Three exposures, three dilutions — share of revenue that is robotics
Physical AI ~1% · Data Center 90% — the picks-and-shovels brain seller to all
Robotics ~10% · semiconductor test 79% — the openness winner (UR) wrapped in semis
Robots 41% (mostly traditional industrial arms) · CNC·service the rest — purest yet closed
Green = robotics share. All three are under half — yet the pick-seller trades the cheapest.
